title: Console routing rehearsal: scenario playback & safety scoring
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Enable a guided 'Rehearsal' flow in Console that lets customers run a scenario-driven playback of a routing policy across regions/tiers/model variants. The feature provides: 1) deterministic simulation of routing decisions given sample request attributes, 2) per-scenario safety and cost scoring (latency, fallback frequency, egress cost), 3) a timeline view that shows when and why a request fell back to a variant, and 4) a publish checklist with automated validation and suggested mitigations. The goal is to reduce misconfigurations that lead to cross-region failovers, high cost due to suboptimal tiering, or silent quality regressions when fallback variants are triggered.
acceptance_criteria: Users can select an existing routing policy and run a scenario with configurable request attributes (region, customer_tier, model_intent, token_length).
Console shows the exact route decision for each simulated request and highlights fallback events with the triggered policy clause and variant name.
Safety scoring surface presents a composite score (latency risk, fallback rate, cost impact) and links to the specific policy clause causing the risk.
Preview includes per-request telemetry estimates: expected p90 latency, estimated token cost, and probability of model-quality degradation for fallback variants (based on historical evals).
Users can export a reproducible scenario and attach it to a support case; the exported bundle includes the policy snapshot and scenario inputs.
Automated preflight validator blocks publish if a policy triggers high fallback rate (>5%) for the selected workload without a configured conservative fallback or rollout policy.
End-to-end tests cover simulation engine correctness for region selection, tier routing, and variant fallback logic.
Design has signed off on mockups and the interaction flow (see design link).
tasks: Spec simulation input schema and map to routing engine evaluator (ENG dependent)
Build lightweight scenario runner in Console that calls /internal/simulate-routing (feature flag behind 'rehearsal')
Surface timeline UI with per-step decision metadata and links to policy clauses
Compute safety score components from telemetry heuristics and historical rollout data
Add export/import payload format and support in support UI
Implement preflight validator rule for high fallback rates
Write unit/integration tests and add e2e scenario tests to CI
